data.long_meaning: Derived from the Japanese words 'hira' meaning mountain and 'i' meaning shining. This name carries a sense of strength and stability, evoking images of a bright and powerful peak. The name Hirai carries the meaning “Shining mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hirai usually hope their child will grow to embody shining mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hirai total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
